mapping_rationale: Explicit 'I'm afraid' framing an anticipated self-state of being too damaged.

Overthinking is purely cognitive rumination, not an enacted behavior (Ruling 1).
Explicit 'I'm afraid of' naming the feared outcome of a wrong choice; matches cluster core.
Evaluative self-appraisal of holding excessive expectations of oneself.
Evaluative appraisal of holding excessive expectations of others.
Uncertainty about a sufficiency threshold; internal evaluative wondering.
Enacted waiting/delay-until-ready stance; alterable, adaptiveness not judged.
Uncertainty/prediction about ever feeling ready; internal conclusion.
Evaluative concern about error; 'don't want' not a stated relational need (Ruling 4).
